Current assessment — 2026-10-05

Reviewed against local main 7057a8d5a2d898c1bfb528a28f3f635dda639b8b, origin/main 568ce108 (local main clean, 112 ahead/0 behind at audit; no push).

Where we are: ScalaFIM currently pins image4s 2c0638fb and reframe4s 5f7152aa. Live public remote tips are image4s c9fcab27 and reframe4s 1ce53535, but remote reachability alone proves neither compatibility nor single classpath identity. The old prescribed one-line pin must be re-evaluated against those exact sources.

Fresh context: Yes: coherent provider closure.

Next action: Inspect the current reframe4s image4s pin and required APIs; admit a coherent provider chain with published exact pins and exported JVM/JS classpaths plus all affected consumer gates. Do not equate native signed-INT8 qualification with diamond resolution.

Evidence: build.sbt; live git ls-remote 2026-10-05; native Atlas F3 ticket.

This is a tracker/source/retained-evidence assessment, not a new experiment or test run. Existing acceptance criteria and owner decisions remain binding; dated source-state statements below are superseded where this assessment explicitly corrects them. Status, priority, assignee, claims and dependency edges are unchanged.

---

Previous scope and history (acceptance retained)

Atlas INT8 review F3: scalafim pins image4s 2c0638fb (now reachable via image4s main c9fcab2) but reframe4s (local 9a450835, origin 5f7152aa) pins image4s 26a74ad, so the default build loads two image4s copies (diamond; scalafim's copy first on JVM; differences additive). build.sbt forwards scalafim.image4s.build -> reframe4s.image4s.build only for local-path overrides. Fix: reframe4s PR pinning image4s c9fcab2, then re-pin scalafim reframe4s (after the origin reconcile) and optionally image4s -> c9fcab2; verify with export atlasJVM/Test/fullClasspath. Upstream PR needs owner OK.
